content: Ifilisṭiniyyen ksin Ttabut n AREBBI uca iwyen tt zi Abin-Haɛizir ɣar Acdud.
Xenni ksin Ifilisṭiniyyen Ttabut n AREBBI uca ssiwḍen tt di taddart n Dajun uca ssarsen tt x uɣezdis n Dajun.
Tiwecca nnes umi imezdaɣ n Acdud kkaren zic, xzar, Dajun tuɣa iwḍa x uɣembub nnes x temmurt zzat i Ttabut n SIDI. Ksin nitni Dajun, ssbedden t ɛawed deg wemcan nnes.

Tiwecca nnes umi dd-kkaren nitni zic ɛawed, xzar, Dajun tuɣa iwḍa ɛawed x uɣembub nnes x temmurt zzat i Ttabut n SIDI, maca azeǧif n Dajun d ifassen nnes s tnayen mmarsen qessen ɣar tnebdat. Mɣir arrimet n Dajun tuɣa teqqim deg wemcan nnes.
X uya war ɛfisen ikehhanen n Dajun d marra inni i dd-ittasen ɣar taddart n Dajun x tnebdat n Dajun di Acdud ař ass-a.
Afus n SIDI idqeř x imezdaɣ n Acdud. Netta issarɛeb i-ten uca iwta ten s tḥebba, di tandint n Acdud d jjwayeh nnes.
Umi iryazen n Acdud ẓrin, aqa ammu i imsar, nnan nitni: “Ttabut n AREBBI n Israil war tzemmar ad ɣarneɣ teqqim, maɣar afus nnes igga xaneɣ ddqeř uřa x arebbi nneɣ Dajun.”

Nitni ssekken iryazen uca ggin ad ssmunen marra řbacat n tneddam n Ifilisṭiniyyen, nnan: “Min ɣa negg s Ttabut n AREBBI n Israil?” Nnan nitni: “Ttabut n AREBBI n Israil ad tᵉttwassmuṭṭiy ɣar Jat.” Xenni ssmuṭṭiyen Ttabut n AREBBI n Israil ɣar Jat.
Maca awarni i umi tt ssmuṭṭiyen, issiweḍ ufus n SIDI ijj n uxarweḍ d ameqqran x tendint nni uca iwta iryazen n tendint, zeg umeẓyan ař ameqqran, s tḥebba innufaren.

Xenni ssekken nitni Ttabut n AREBBI ɣar Ɛaqrun. Umi dd-tusa Ttabut n AREBBI ɣar Ɛaqrun, imsar, aqa imezdaɣ n Ɛaqrun sɣuyen, nnan: “Nitni iwyen-dd Ttabut n AREBBI n Israil ɣarneɣ danita, ḥima ad aneɣ nɣen uřa d řgens nneɣ.”

Ssekken nitni ireqqasen uca ggin ad ssmunen marra řbacat n tneddam n Ifilisṭiniyyen, nnan: “Siggʷejem Ttabut n AREBBI n Israil, jjem tt ad dd-tedweř ɣar wemcan nnes, ḥima war d ayi ineqq uřa d řgens inu!”, minzi tuɣa din ijj n uqezzeb imɣar di marra tandint uca afus n AREBBI idqeř aṭṭas x Ɛaqrun.
Iwdan, inni war immuten, tuɣa ttwawten s tḥebba, ařami aɣuyyi n usɣati n tendint igeɛɛed ɣar ujenna sennej.
